name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon coils among its glassware like a collector guarding a laboratory, neck arched, head raised and turned toward the camera with a sly, appraising gaze, a thin curl of mist rising from its jaws.
components.background: a fetid fen grotto of twisted roots and still black water, glowing toxic mushrooms and drifting marsh lights, low creeping mist
components.hoard: shelves and heaps of glass vials, alembics and corked potion flasks, venom-etched daggers, jars of strange specimens, tarnished brass goblets, uncut pink tourmalines and poisoned jewels
components.effects: A few faint tendrils of toxic mist curl across the hoard, glowing softly - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
